newsitem.title: USA: Universal Pictures signs long-term production deal.
newsitem.headline: Universal Pictures signs long-term production deal.

text.p: Universal Pictures Thursday said it entered into a long-term motion picture production and distribution agreement with Beacon Communications.

Under the terms of the five-year agreement, Beacon Communications will serve as a major supplier of motion pictures to Universal Pictures, delivering up to four films a year for the studio for theatrical distribution across North America.
Armyan Bernstein, Chairman of Beacon Communications, will take an active producing role on the features produced under the agreement.

The company's current production slate includes "A.F.O.", an action-thriller starring Harrison Ford; "A Thousand Acres", based on the Pulitzer Prize-winning novel by Jane Smiley and starring Michelle Pfeiffer, Jessica Lange and Jennifer Jason Leigh; and "Playing God", starring David Duchovny.
Universal Pictures is part of Seagram Co Ltd's MCA Inc.
